instruction: I need to remove all Amazon cookies from my browser for privacy reasons. Please delete all cookies associated with Amazon.com.

metadata.explanation: Task requires deleting Amazon cookies, same as original but with different instruction phrasing. Uses existing is_cookie_deleted metric to verify .amazon.com cookies are removed.
metadata.verification: The is_cookie_deleted function checks if any cookie domain matches .amazon.com. Returns 1.0 if no Amazon cookies found, 0.0 otherwise.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic correctly verifies the instruction requirement: checks that all Amazon cookies are deleted
Getter (get_cookie_data) properly extracts all cookies from Chrome's SQLite database
Metric (is_cookie_deleted) correctly checks if any cookie domain matches '.amazon.com' using compare_urls, returns 1.0 only if no Amazon cookies exist
Postconfig appropriately handles state freshness by killing Chrome to flush cookies to disk, then restarting and waiting 3 seconds for database availability
Expected value '.amazon.com' is the correct domain pattern for Amazon cookies
Data flow is correct: getter extracts all cookies → metric checks domains → returns 1.0 if no Amazon domains found, 0.0 otherwise
Logic will work correctly at runtime: Chrome restart ensures cookies are persisted, getter can access SQLite database, metric performs correct domain matching
